verdict.rationale: RustDesk offers its own pre-configured clients: a custom-branded client generator on the Basic plan, more than 90 configurable options, and centralized settings. A community user also reports setting the Windows client's server through the .exe filename. However, nothing in the pack documents an MSI package, MDM deployment, or silent-install switches for pushing those preset clients to a fleet. Missing for 10: documented MSI installer, MDM/GPO deployment guidance, silent-install command-line flags, independent hands-on corroboration of mass deployment.
